Class LogAppender.Builder

java.lang.Object
io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogAppender.Builder
All Implemented Interfaces:
LogBuilder<LogAppender.Builder, LogAppender>
Enclosing interface:
LogAppender
public static final class LogAppender.Builder extends Object implements LogBuilder<LogAppender.Builder, LogAppender>
Builder for creating standard appenders. Whatever is not set explicitly is resolved from properties keyed under LogProperties.APPENDER_PREFIX for this builder's name (see fromProperties(LogProperties)), and failing that from a small set of defaults: no encoder resolves one from the output's own type, no flags means none are set, and no appender type means LogAppender.AppenderType.LOCK_THREAD_LOCAL_BUFFER - or LogAppender.AppenderType.AUTO_DETECT instead, if LogProperties.GLOBAL_OPTIMIZE_PROPERTY is enabled. There is deliberately no such default for output, since a required source is not something a generic named appender can safely guess, except for the well known "console"/ "file" names, which register their own fallback via outputDefault(LogProvider).

      public LogAppender.Builder appenderType(LogAppender.AppenderType appenderType)
      Sets the appender type (buffer/locking strategy). If not set it is resolved from LogAppender.APPENDER_TYPE_PROPERTY or otherwise defaults to LogAppender.AppenderType.LOCK_THREAD_LOCAL_BUFFER (LogAppender.AppenderType.AUTO_DETECT instead if LogProperties.GLOBAL_OPTIMIZE_PROPERTY is enabled).     • fromProperties

      public LogAppender.Builder fromProperties(LogProperties properties)
      Fills in whatever of flags/appender type is not already explicitly set on this builder from properties keyed under propertyPrefix() for this builder's name; an already-set field always wins over the property, matching every other generated builder's fromProperties in this project. Both are resolved and validated together against one LogProperty.Validator, so a builder with both malformed reports both in a single exception rather than just the first one reached.

      Output/encoder are deliberately not handled here even though they too are keyed under propertyPrefix(): turning either into a concrete, registered LogOutput/LogEncoder needs a LogConfig (to actually look up the URI scheme), which this method does not have. build() resolves those two once a real LogConfig is available, using the same property keys.

      Specified by:
      fromProperties in interface LogBuilder<LogAppender.Builder, LogAppender>
      Parameters:
      properties - properties to resolve unset fields from.
      Returns:
      this.
